checks.name: context_setup_positive
argv:
import json,sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
e=r.get("environment",{})
ok=e.get("injected_env")=={"GIT_DIR":"/nonexistent/tameshi-round14-poison"} and e.get("env_delta_keys")==["GIT_DIR"] and e.get("baseline_has_GIT_DIR") is False
print("context_setup_recorded" if ok else "missing_injected_environment")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

checks.name: runner_variable_swap_discriminator
argv:
import json,runpy,sys
from pathlib import Path
h=runpy.run_path(".ufo/evidence/round-14/capture-context.py")
r=Path("tools/mutate-and-run.sh").read_text()
m=json.loads(Path(".ufo/evidence/round-13/pin-manifest.json").read_text())["legs"]
p=h["parse_runner_mapping"](r)
assert h["mapping_block"](p,m)["all_match"]
body=h["RUN_REGRESSION_RE"].search(r)
assert body is not None
old=body.group("body")
assert old.count('"$REV_BASH"')==1
mutated=old.replace('"$REV_BASH"','"$REV_CHECKLIST"',1)
r=r[:body.start("body")]+mutated+r[body.end("body"):]
out=h["mapping_block"](h["parse_runner_mapping"](r),m)
row=next(x for x in out["legs"] if x["leg"]=="bash-surface-census")
assert not out["all_match"] and not row["checks"]["constant_names_match_leg"]
print("runner_variable_swap_rejected: equal REV values do not hide wrong binding")
checks.stdout: runner_variable_swap_rejected: equal REV values do not hide wrong binding
